title: Sormano and de Vaulx (Passano) from Ferrara to Francois I, Feb 1529, BnF fr. 3096 nos. 63, 65, 66

steps.what: Located the pieces on the microfilm; glyph segmentation and eight classifier/LM decoding attempts
Lasry's published key applied; 20 of 22 independently derived values confirmed
Duke's-answer passage of no. 65 read and checked against the twin no. 66

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's key for Sormano's cipher, published on Tomokiyo's cryptiana francis.htm (2023) and found during the attempt after eight failed ciphertext-only attempts on the microfilm, was applied to short passages of no. 65 and checked against the duplicate no. 66.
outcome.notes: Key complete; only short passages read, the three letters not transcribed with it. fraction_read is an estimate from the NOTES, not measured.

gaps.detail: Lasry's key is in hand (section 6) and the hybrid method of 5d works, but no transcription with it was made

gaps.item: no. 65 (ff. 119-120) cipher beyond the Duke's-answer passage
i/o homophone forms confusable on the microfilm
gaps.detail: 50-60 px glyphs on MF 31394, several forms differ by less than the film records (5b); a new capture would settle them

outcome.fraction_read_source: no reading file: the three letters were never transcribed with Lasry's key (key_lasry.tsv); only short passages read in NOTES prose

prior.where: Lasry's key published on Tomokiyo, French Ciphers during the Reign of Francis I (2023); letters not printed (Molini)
